D5/S1/Deficit/DeficitInteger.deficit.name: D5.S1.Deficit.deficit
D5/S1/Deficit/DeficitInteger.deficit.signature: noncomputable def deficit (v₁ v₂ : ℕ) : ℝ

D5/S1/Deficit/DeficitInteger.deficit_int.name: D5.S1.Deficit.deficit_integer
D5/S1/Deficit/DeficitInteger.deficit_int.signature: theorem deficit_integer (v₁ v₂ : ℕ) : deficit v₁ v₂ = deficitContraction v₁ v₂ ∧ (∃ z : ℤ, deficit v₁ v₂ = (z : ℝ)) ∧ deficit v₁ v₂ = (carrySignedCount (toRaw (Z v₁) + toRaw (Z v₂)) : ℝ)

D5/S1/Deficit/DeficitThreeValued.deficit.name: D5.S1.Deficit.deficit_three_valued
D5/S1/Deficit/DeficitThreeValued.deficit.signature: theorem deficit_three_valued (v₁ v₂ : ℕ) : deficit v₁ v₂ = -1 ∨ deficit v₁ v₂ = 0 ∨ deficit v₁ v₂ = 1

D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Restoration/Target.name: D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Restoration.TargetRecoveryCriterion.target_recovery_criterion
D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Restoration/Target.signature: theorem target_recovery_criterion {X ProcessState Target : Type*} [Nonempty X] (process : Concept X ProcessState) (target : Concept X Target) : ((∃ recover : ProcessState → Target, target = recover ∘ process) ↔ ∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, process x = process y → target x = target y) ∧ ((∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, process x = process y → target x = target y) ↔ defectRelation process target = ∅) ∧ (defectRelation process target = ∅ ↔ ∃ recover : ProcessState → Target, target = recover ∘ process) ∧ ((¬∃ recover : ProcessState → Target, target = recover ∘ process) ↔ (defectRelation process target).Nonempty)
